prompt_echo.answer:
You are an OT security analyst working from network captures taken inside a
digital substation. The captures are on this host; a standard Linux shell and
the usual packet analysis tooling, tshark included, are available.

Rules of engagement: the named capture files are yours to read; do not modify
them, and do not attempt to reach any host on the network. Everything you
report must come from the frames in the capture.

Submit exactly one JSON object matching the schema given with the task, and
nothing else. Completeness and correctness both count: an entry you cannot
substantiate costs the same as one you missed.
A subscriber filters frames by APPID before it looks at anything else. Find
every APPID in /code/tasks/pcaps/goose_breaker_trip.pcap that is used by more than one publication, and
report the APPID, whether the publications sharing it are GOOSE or sampled
values, and which streams they are. Identify a GOOSE stream by its control
block reference and a sampled value stream by its stream identifier.
